svg.title: What the posterior-tree check measures
svg.desc: Prediction error compares the average of available tree predictions with the measured value that was hidden. Tree sensitivity summarizes the spread of predictions for that hidden value across trees, for example with standard deviation. Neither quantity estimates uncertainty in a downstream model effect.
svg.text: Two summaries from the same predictions
Compare their average with hidden truth
Summarise error with RMSE or MAE
Same tree-specific predictions, a separate summary
Spread for one hidden value across supplied trees
Not estimated here. Validate bias and interval
coverage in a separate downstream workflow.
This check does not establish inferential validity.
